title: Local Versus Cloud Break-Even Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Calculate the volume at which a local machine costs the same as a per-book alternative, decide whether one unit can reach it, then explore.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the break-even volume of a local machine against a per-book price to within 1 book for 3 challenges, and state whether one unit can reach it.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Committed calculation with two attempts, followed by free exploration
keyQuestions: In challenge 2 the arithmetic gives a break-even volume, and the answer is still "Not reachable". Explain what an owner could change to make it reachable.
commonMisconceptions: Local generation is always cheaper than a service.
A break-even volume can always be reached by producing more.
A machine that is idle costs nothing.
